cases.input: Agreement A expires while confidentiality and evidence-retention duties have explicit survival clocks.
cases.expect: Primary delivery duties may release, while surviving obligations and evidence remain active and resolvable.

cases.input: Amendment E2 changes one clause and leaves another unchanged.
cases.expect: Historic expressions remain citable and only affected obligations are re-derived.

cases.input: Two reciprocal performance duties form an unresolved cycle.
cases.expect: The cycle is surfaced with attributed edges and is not silently linearized.

cases.input: Fulfilment evidence for one occurrence is later revoked.
cases.expect: A reopening event is appended without rewriting the original evidence or occurrence.

cases.input: Agreement expiry automatically discharges every duty and deletes its evidence.
cases.expect: The inference and deletion are rejected.

cases.input: A deadline passes with no evidence and the duty is marked fulfilled.
cases.expect: Fulfilment is rejected; overdue and discharge remain separate facets.

cases.input: Conflicting duties across agreements are resolved by selecting the newest agreement automatically.
cases.expect: The computed winner is rejected; attributed conflicts are referred to authorized review.

cases.input: A user edits a reciprocal edge in the Obligation Network rendering.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; the edge is mastered as a WM-XCT-029 obligation association.

cases.input: A surviving duty still cites its source clause after the agreement expires.
cases.expect: The historical source reference remains resolvable without making the agreement live.

cases.input: A surviving retention duty references evidence mastered by WM-REC-001.
cases.expect: The record remains governed by its record authority and is disclosed only through the pinned shape.

cases.input: A decomposition cycle is deleted to make the graph acyclic.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected; the cycle is retained and surfaced for WM-ACT-034 assessment.

cases.input: A projection digest omits party lens or access decision.
cases.expect: The projection is rejected as non-reproducible and unsafe.

cases.input: A projection cites evidence without a resolvable record authority or evidence-reference revision.
cases.expect: Generation fails closed; WM-XCT-029 never assumes evidence mastership.

cases.input: Disclosure hides a duty node but leaves an incident edge or placeholder.
cases.expect: The edge is also hidden and no placeholder reveals the node existence.

cases.input: An overdue view pins calendar revision, time zone, clock basis and as-of.
cases.expect: Overdue is reproducibly derived at read time and not stored as authoritative duty state.

cases.input: Cycle detection writes an assessment flag into the read-only projection.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; diagnostics are non-mutating and out of band.

cases.input: Obligation Network is registered as a second model beside Enterprise Contract Landscape.
cases.expect: Registration is rejected because it is only a rendering mode.

cases.input: Two authorized party lenses generate different projection digests over the same masters.
cases.expect: The digest difference is treated as lens-scoped output difference, not proof of source-content difference.
